title: Unnecessary .groups object for waldo::compare()
description:
In three milestones, `waldo::compare()` relies on a named object `.groups`, which is named in the first code chunk. These are the three milestones:
1. mdrd_02_quarto_summarize.qmd
2. mdrd_03_quarto_wrangle.qmd
3. mdrd_04_quarto_tidy.qmd

For better or worse, some learners don't run the first code chunk before they get down to the comparison. This means they run into an error that's hard to understand: "**Error: object '.groups' not found**"

In all three instances, avoiding defining a `.groups` object would make the document easier to work with. The change would be an easy project-wide search and replace: 
`ignore_attr = .groups` ⇾ `ignore_attr = c("class", "groups")`

Then the definition of .groups could also be deleted: 
`groups <- c("class", "groups")`

I've looked into the milestone files of one other project and can see that it follows a similar pattern suggested here, so the change would also simplify maintenance by making the projects more similar. (But it's possible that yet other projects could also benefit from this same change.)
